visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor with short hair and glasses, wearing a tan blazer and pearl necklace, sits at a desk in a bright office. She gestures with her hands while speaking. The background features a large brown designer bag and a clinic logo "DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC". (2) Scene transitions with various colorful text overlays appearing over the doctor as she continues her explanation. She uses wide hand movements to emphasize her points. (3) The visual cuts to an animation showing uncontrolled cell division in skin layers, followed by a close-up of a raw skin injury being cleaned with a cotton swab. (4) Another close-up shows a medical laser device emitting a red light pulse onto skin with acne scars. (5) A detailed animation illustrates melanin production and distribution within the dermis layers. (6) The doctor is shown again, now with multiple floating text elements surrounding her. She appears confident and reassuring. (7) A final end card displays the "DRX" logo, social media handles, contact numbers, and two physical addresses in Traditional Chinese.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Statement -> Biological Explanation -> Solution -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to debunk myths and alleviate patient anxiety regarding post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (反黑) after laser treatments. It positions the doctor as an honest expert who explains that PIH is a natural biological response (melanin activity) rather than a medical error, and promotes the clinic's professional solutions (whitening creams, retinoids) to reduce its occurrence to as low as 5%.
